blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements for Identity Protection.

Identity Protection includes automation rules as part of its Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) capability. Automation rules automatically trigger the appropriate playbook based on specific conditions, including event severity, entity types such as users and identity findings, or threat category. This eliminates the need for manual response and remediation of recurring or similar security incidents.
To learn more, see About Automation Rules.

Identity Protection includes playbooks as part of its Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) capability. You can configure a sequence of automated remediation actions for entities such as users and identity findings, including enabling multi-factor authentication (MFA), clearing user sessions, and suspending users. Playbooks can be run manually or through automation rules, which ensures faster and consistent responses to security incidents.
To learn more, see About Playbooks.
You can view historical measure conditions for items in a dashboard widget. The items that match the condition are displayed in the state they were in during the specified time period.
To learn more, see Viewing Items in a Widget Segment.
